added_lines: . to access this information, click on the webpage, then click on the tab ‘cemeteries’, enter farnivane under cemetery name and hit search. this gives a complete list of all those interred in st martins. alternatively, enter the name of the deceased in the search area but be aware that the location of the cemetery is listed as bandon. . parish phone number murragh & templemartin

. the priest on duty for murragh & templemartin for the week will have access to this phone. . . mass intentions as and from the 1st november 2023, all masses may be offered for more than one intention. to book a mass please email

. murragh and templemartin parish – part of a family of parishes murragh and templemartin is now part of a family of parishes which also includes bandon, enniskeane & desertserges, innishannon/knockavilla and kilbrittain murragh & templemartin does not have a resident parish priest. the pastoral needs of the parish are covered by the other priests in our family of parishes. these priests reside outside of the parish of murragh & templemartin but minister across the whole family of parishes. fr john newman (bandon) is the moderator. . . easy and safe donations our new online donation feature on this website makes it easy to donate securely to the parish. this is great for once-off donations or regular offerings to the parish.
